title: Gemini Crosses 1 Billion Users
body: Google says Gemini has crossed 1 billion monthly users. The bigger shift is multimodal AI: 🎙 Voice 📸 Camera 🖥 Screen sharing 🖼 Image generation AI interfaces are moving beyond simple chatbots. ⚡ KEY TAKEAWAYS • 1 Billion+ monthly active user milestone • Native multimodal support: voice, camera, screen sharing & image generation 💡 WHY IT MATTERS Highlights the rapid transition from text-only chatbots to ubiquitous multimodal AI interfaces.
